source_label: B&Q customer reviews for Tower T16043GRY
praise: Several comments on B&Q's T16043GRY page praise its appearance, while MichelleWenham and Debbie S mention easy cleaning. ALLANPAINTER describes a successful beef-joint meal, and Mary C reports good casserole results.
limitations: The page displays ten reviews, mostly from 2022–2025. One gift buyer explicitly had not seen it used yet. A lower-rated comment questions the coating, but provides no test evidence; it does not establish a material or health finding. This small sample cannot establish long-term reliability.
verdict: Worth comparing if you want a large, simple slow cooker and care about worktop appearance. The comments offer encouraging everyday-use examples, but check the current manual, dimensions and materials before choosing. Our conclusion is based on published feedback, not a performance test.

source_label: eBay product reviews for the Design Series 7-Quart thermal-bag model
praise: In the product-review section, a June 2026 reviewer reports a successful bone-broth result. A second reviewer in July says they had not yet used their purchase. Both comments are labelled verified purchases of pre-owned units.
limitations: Only two product reviews are displayed, and just one describes using the purchase. That is too little evidence to judge reliability, temperature consistency or value across owners. Seller delivery feedback elsewhere on the page is excluded from this assessment.
verdict: Keep it on a shortlist if the carrying-bag design meets your needs, but treat the owner evidence as preliminary. Check the exact model, included bag, warranty and return terms; two ratings do not justify calling it a proven best performer.
